purpose: Capture only the missing adaptive producer inputs needed to reproduce LSC0/LSC1 and GTM0 offline for the same Windows requests 4,5,6.

adaptive_state_to_hash_and_dump_locally: LSC common input enable/state flags including Tintless and ALSC
sensor calibration table inputs referenced by LSC411
final common LSC output before Titan680 packing

common_input_fields.alsc_scratch_size: dwo(x0+0x100), exact implementation requires at least 0xc000 when used

capture_sequence: For each request 4/5/6, log frame id and the seven geometry fields before any local dump.

If the calibration input is not already present in an existing artifact, capture/hash only the proven runtime OTP table(s) or the bounded physical EEPROM 0x103d..0x1724 window; do not dump an unbounded EEPROM object.
If channel-correction pointers +0xd0/+0xd8/+0xe0/+0xe8 are non-null, dump exactly 0x374 bytes from each.
Record +0xa0/+0xa8/+0xb8/+0xf8 pointer identities and enable flags; inspect type/size before following unknown-size objects.
At caller RVA 0xa03b34, dump/hash x19+0xac for 0x18a0 bytes and the three DMI destinations before Titan680 packing.

post_calculate_caller_state.final_lsc_staging: x19+0xac, dump 0x18a0 bytes (exact Titan680 packer reads through at least +0x1896)

static_eeprom_boundary.capture_preference: Prefer the already-materialized runtime OTP slot/common calibration state at the same request. Only capture the bounded physical 0x6e8 EEPROM window if an offline copy cannot be recovered and the runtime OTP table is unavailable.

preferred_capture_boundary.reason: Exact GTM131 hardware-setting entry after the 257-float interpolation and after published TMC state has been converted into the internal layout consumed by GTM.
capture_locally: x0 GTM common input: 0x7c bytes (pointer-bearing raw bytes local only; decode proven fields at +0x14/+0x2a/+0x34/+0x50/+0x70/+0x74/+0x78)
x1: exact 0x404-byte / 257-float interpolated GTM region input
x2: first dword of GTM calculation flags
x3: halfword at +0x4 used by the exact GTM setting output
poi(x0+0x50): generation-5 sparse internal TMC ranges totaling at most 0x108c bytes
post-calculation 0x800-byte GTM staging/output for request correlation

tmc_v5_sparse_ranges.purpose: 15-float cubic coefficient block used when mode==2
fail-safe maximum dynamic tone-curve domain; exact helper uses 0x400 bytes only for hw-version 0x60400, otherwise 0x1000

fail_closed_checks: Filter RVA 0x9aa6e0 hits to LR == 0x180a28f2c so only the IFE GTM call is accepted.
dwo(poi(x0+0x50)+0x08) must equal 5 before using the generation-5 sparse-layout contract; otherwise stop and revise the static branch contract.
Raw pointer-bearing/common/TMC dumps stay local/untracked; commit only hashes and decoded bounded metadata.
capture_sequence: For each request 4/5/6, break at RVA 0x9aa6e0 and accept only LR 0x180a28f2c.
Log request/frame correlation, x0..x4, the selected TMC pointer poi(x0+0x50), and the fail-closed generation/valid fields before any range dump.
Dump the seven exact generation-5 sparse TMC ranges only; do not dump an assumed contiguous 0x6300/0x8278 object.
Hash/dump x1 for 0x404 bytes, x2 for 4 bytes, x3+4 for 2 bytes, and the x0 common input for 0x7c bytes.
After return, at RVA 0xa2908c or 0xa290a8, hash/dump the exact 0x800-byte result/cached staging and correlate it to the matched request DMI oracle.
Keep all raw memory dumps local/untracked; commit only hashes, exact range metadata, and offline reconstruction results.

gtm_hw_setting_entry.x2: GTM calculation flags; first dword is consumed
gtm_hw_setting_entry.x3: aux setting input; halfword at +0x4 is consumed

capture_policy.committed_artifacts: hashes, decoded bounded metadata, scripts and conclusions only
capture_policy.atomicity: Use frame id from the exact ISPInputData in the same function context; do not correlate adaptive state to DMI across separate Windows streams.

acceptance_gate: Offline producer must reproduce matched Windows LSC0, LSC1 and GTM0 byte-for-byte; derive wire GIC from the proven LSC alias; then run a separate authorization review before any Linux request6 runtime.
